---
title: "Facets and composition"
---

## Small multiples

`facetWrap()` draws one panel per level of a field and wraps them into rows. `ncol:` or `nrow:` sets the layout. `scales:` is `fixed`, `free`, `free_x`, or `free_y`. Statistical layers, such as the linear fits below, are computed per panel.

{{< include _generated/facet-wrap.md >}}

`labeller: 'both'` labels panels as "field: value", as ggplot2's `label_both` does. A map such as `labeller: ['f' => 'Front', 'r' => 'Rear']` renames values, and a grid takes one map per field: `labeller: ['drv' => [...], 'year' => [...]]`. `header:` passes Vega-Lite header properties such as `labelFontWeight`.

`facetGrid()` lays panels out by a `rows:` field and a `cols:` field.

{{< include _generated/facet-grid.md >}}

`size()` sets the size of each panel when a plot is faceted. Reference lines and `curve()` layers appear in every panel.

## Composition

`Compose::beside()`, `Compose::stack()`, and `Compose::grid()` lay out separate plots as patchwork does for ggplot2. A composition takes a title, a theme, and Vega-Lite `resolve` rules for shared or independent scales and legends.

{{< include _generated/facet-compose.md >}}

Selections defined in one plot of a composition can filter or highlight the others. [Interaction](interaction.qmd) shows a linked brush.
